dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave curvature along the posterior edge of the low-polygon mesh.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute apex with a minimal rounded pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 30-degree upward slope relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 2:1 ratio of base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve defining the anterior-dorsal cranial slope.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt pixel projection with high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle at the junction point of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast cyan and green bioluminescent-style texture mapping along the lateral line and head.
